description: Public derived dataset (483 columns): 8 auxiliary columns excluded after equivalence verification.
exclusion_reason: These 8 columns (order_CH* and time_CH*) are not used as ML predictors when scenario.exclude_order_time=True (the default). Their removal is mathematically equivalent for all 20 experimental scenarios, verified by comparing X, y, and groups matrices across all channel-phoneme combinations.
equivalence_scope: All 20 scenarios (4 channels × 5 phonemes): X_audio, X_emg, y, groups
privacy_note: This dataset contains numeric participant identifiers (id_subject). Release requires human authorization. See docs/DATA_RELEASE_REVIEW.md.
WARNING: Do not publish this file without explicit authorization from the authors and completion of the privacy review in docs/DATA_RELEASE_REVIEW.md.
